source_equations.fm_bass: f_inst=f_c + f_c*I(t)*sin(2*pi*f_m*t); I(t)=I0*exp(-1.5t); add sub oscillator
source_equations.normalization: peak-normalize each one-shot to 0.88; 3ms linear attack; measured RMS/peak in preset metadata

family_equations.phase_burst: phi[n+1]=phi[n]+2*pi*f[n]/sr; f[n]=f0*(1+fm*sin(2*pi*fm_rate*t)); hard phase reset at field crossings
family_equations.noise_orbit: y=filtered_noise*E(t)+sum_j sin(2*pi*f_j*t+phase_field)/j; spectral brightness follows release
